Frequently asked questions about Paulo Cesar Zanovelli
 Sample of 20 matches, from 07/05/2026 to 14/11/2026. Answers refer to the matches in the table and the selected filters.
 Card totals and percentages use yellow plus red cards in this sample.
 What is Paulo Cesar Zanovelli’s average number of cards per match?
 Paulo Cesar Zanovelli averages 5.00 yellow cards and 0.55 red cards per match across the 20 matches analysed: 5.55 cards per match in total.
 What are Paulo Cesar Zanovelli’s penalty statistics?
 Paulo Cesar Zanovelli has awarded 5 penalties in the 20 matches analysed, averaging 0.25 per match.
 How often does Paulo Cesar Zanovelli exceed 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cards?
 Across the 20 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 75.0% of matches, 4.5 in 60.0% and 5.5 in 60.0%.
 How much does Paulo Cesar Zanovelli’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 20 matches analysed, 15.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 25.0% with 3–5 and 60.0% with 6 or more.
 How do Paulo Cesar Zanovelli’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 5.40 cards, compared with 5.55 across all 20 matches analysed.
 How does Paulo Cesar Zanovelli distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 2.30 yellow cards and away teams 2.70. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
